title: NGINX: Web Server, Reverse Proxy & Load Balancer
blurb: NGINX from zero: what a web server, reverse proxy and load balancer are, how nginx.conf is put together, location matching, load balancing, rate limiting, caching, TLS, authentication, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3, containers and cloud, monitoring, logs, tuning, a full worked deployment and interview answers.
sources: Official docs: nginx.org/en/docs (core, proxy, upstream, limit_req, limit_conn, cache, ssl, v2, v3, stream, njs, otel)
Official docs: docs.nginx.com (NGINX Plus features), letsencrypt.org, kubernetes.io (Ingress)
